acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

approve(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-approve}. NOTE: If `value` is the maximum `uint256`, the allowance is not updated on `transferFrom`. This is semantically equivalent to an infinite approval. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

cancelRegistry().details: Testnet/bootstrap only: with a zero current registry, only the owner may cancel.

claimMusharakahProfit(uint256).details: Requires `purificationEscrow` to be set (setPurificationEscrow).         The escrow contract enforces the full invariant:           purified + charity + vaultShare + depositorShare == grossProfit         v1 ZakatModule path has been removed. Existing v1 vaults retain their         ZakatModule and continue to function — only new profit claims use this path.

confirmRegistry().details: Testnet/bootstrap only: if the current registry is zero, the owner may      confirm immediately without a board check.

decimals().details: Decimals are computed by adding the decimal offset on top of the underlying asset's decimals. This "original" value is cached during construction of the vault contract. If this read operation fails (e.g., the asset has not been created yet), a default of 18 is used to represent the underlying asset's decimals. See {IERC20Metadata-decimals}.

deployCapital(address,uint256,bytes).details: Transfer-only compatibility path for non-gold strategies; configured gold requires atomic execution.

exitSettle(uint256).details: The outer withdrawal holds the lock until after the burn and asset transfer.

goldWritedown().details: Unreadable valuations contribute zero writedown; entry is blocked via valuationHealthy().

maxDeposit(address).details: Failed valuation reads or non-gold losses above dust block entry, never exits.         Withdrawals and redemptions remain priced at marked NAV.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingDistributionCut().details: Failed escrow previews reserve nothing and never gate exits.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

proposeRegistry(address).details: Testnet/bootstrap only: a zero current registry permits owner proposal      and immediate confirmation without a board check or delay.

recallCapital(address,uint256).details: If post-recall valuation fails, only measured token recovery retires principal; no loss is inferred.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setGoldAllocationAdapter(address).details: Only used for cap calculation — does not screen the adapter.         Call setScreened(adapter, true) separately.

setGoldSpreadAdapter(address).details: Only used for cap calculation — does not screen the adapter.         Call setScreened(adapter, true) separately.

setPurificationEscrow(address).details: Must be set before claimMusharakahProfit() can be called.         The escrow must be constructed with this vault's address, asset,         a CharityModule, and the shariahTreasury.

settleCrossChain(uint64,uint256).details: J1: Degraded path — `received` MUST be 0. Books the full sent amount as a loss.         Only callable by the owner (not the manager) to prevent accidental write-offs.

params.positionId: Local pending-position ID emitted by deployCrossChain.

settleCrossChainWithMessage(uint64,bytes.details: J1: Replaces the old snapshot-based approach. Nothing else can move the USDC         balance inside a single call, so `received` is always exact.         Also verifies that the decoded mintRecipient is this vault and that the         message-encoded amount matches the actual balance delta.

params.message: Attested CCTP message bytes (returned by the CCTP attestation API).
params.positionId: Local pending-position ID emitted by deployCrossChain, not a CCTP nonce.

transfer(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transfer}. Requirements: - `to` cannot be the zero address. - the caller must have a balance of at least `value`.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transferFrom}. Skips emitting an {Approval} event indicating an allowance update. This is not required by the ERC. See {xref-ERC20-_approve-address-address-uint256-bool-}[_approve]. NOTE: Does not update the allowance if the current allowance is the maximum `uint256`. Requirements: - `from` and `to` cannot be the zero address. - `from` must have a balance of at least `value`. - the caller must have allowance for ``from``'s tokens of at least `value`.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

valuationHealthy().details: Failed reads remain unmarked in NAV and never gate withdrawals or redemptions.

writeOffAdapterPrincipal(address).details: A zero or unreadable position can be explicitly written off by the owner; principal and deployed cost retire atomically.

ADAPTER_READ_GAS().notice: Maximum gas forwarded to each adapter currentValue() read.

MAX_FUNDED_ADAPTERS().notice: Maximum number of funded non-gold adapters.

MAX_GOLD_BPS().notice: Hard cap: combined S2-H (PAXG) + S6-H (XAUT) value must not exceed 30% of totalAssets.

cancelDustThreshold().notice: Board cancels a pending threshold proposal.

cancelRegistry().notice: Current board cancels a pending registry proposal without waiting.

claimMusharakahProfit(uint256).notice: Distribute Shariah profit through the v2 waterfall (purification → sadaqah → Musharakah).

confirmDustThreshold().notice: Board confirms after the delay, subject to the current asset-based cap.

confirmRegistry().notice: Current board confirms after the delay and clears any pending dust proposal.

deployCapital(address,uint256,bytes).notice: Override deployCapital to enforce Shariah screening and accrue Wakala fee.

deployCapitalAndExecute(address,uint256,.notice: Transfer capital and execute the adapter atomically with this vault as caller.

deployCrossChainForStrategy(uint8,uint32.notice: Strategy-tagged cross-chain transfer. A gold strategy (S2-H, S6-H) is never routed         cross-chain: this entry point always moves USDC over CCTP, and domain 0 is a real         CCTP domain (Ethereum), not "local". Gold strategies that execute locally go         through deployCapital / the executor instead.

dustThreshold().notice: Minimum adapter principal (USDC, 6 dec) that triggers a deposit pause when price is stale.         An adapter at or below effectiveDustThreshold() never blocks deposits even if stale.         Default 1e6 = 1 USDC. Changes require board approval and a 30-day delay.

effectiveDustThreshold().notice: Board-set threshold clamped to the current asset-based cap at enforcement time.

exitSettle(uint256).notice: Revertible exit-only profit distribution; never callable by a third party.

fundedAdapters(uint256).notice: Non-gold adapters with outstanding principal; order changes on removal.

goldAllocationAdapter().notice: S6-H gold allocation adapter (GoldAllocationAdapter — XAUT). Used for combined cap check.

goldSpreadAdapter().notice: S2-H gold spread adapter (GoldExchangeAdapter — PAXG). Used for combined cap check.

goldUnrealizedGain().notice: Aggregate appreciation above principal for the tracked gold adapters.

goldWritedown().notice: Aggregate loss below principal for the tracked gold adapters.

highWaterMark().notice: Asset equivalent of the processed per-share high at the current virtual supply.

highWaterMarkPerShare().notice: Highest processed realized assets per share, including locked depositor profit, scaled by 1e18.

hwmDeficit().notice: Live unrecovered loss on the processed basis, including locked profit, excluding paper appreciation.

lockedProfit().notice: Profit locked for linear unlock (PR3.2 — Yearn-style streaming).         Locked profit is excluded from totalAssets until unlockedAt.

maxDeposit(address).notice: Returns 0 when gold prices are insane or adapter valuations are unhealthy.

maxMint(address).notice: Mirror of maxDeposit — blocks minting on insane prices or unhealthy valuations.

maxPendingCrossChainBps().notice: Max fraction of totalAssets allowed in-flight cross-chain (default 2000 = 20%).

messageTransmitter().notice: CCTP V2 MessageTransmitter used by settleCrossChainWithMessage.         Set via setMessageTransmitter(). Optional — only needed for atomic settle.

pendingDistributionCut().notice: Unbooked purification, charity and manager share on all current realized profit.

pendingWakalaFee().notice: Unbooked time-based fee on realized AUM, already reflected in share pricing.

principalOf(address).notice: Outstanding locally funded principal per adapter, independent of recall proceeds.

profitBase().notice: Principal checkpoint in net asset units; deposits are not realized profit.

profitUnlockPeriod().notice: Duration over which profit is linearly streamed into NAV (default 3 days).

proposeDustThreshold(uint256).notice: Board proposes a capped threshold with a 30-day delay.

proposeRegistry(address).notice: Current board proposes a nonzero registry with a 30-day delay.

proposeRemoteRecipient(uint32,bytes32,bo.notice: Board proposes an approval or revocation; both require the full delay.

purificationEscrow().notice: v2 profit-distribution waterfall: purification → sadaqah → Musharakah split.         Set via setPurificationEscrow(). If zero, claimMusharakahProfit reverts.

realizedProfit().notice: Net realized assets above the checkpoint; gold appreciation is never distributable.

recallCapital(address,uint256).notice: Retire requested principal (all remaining principal on full exit) when valuation is readable.

retiredGoldAdapter(address).notice: Previously tracked gold adapters cannot receive capital until explicitly linked again.

returnCapital(address,uint256).notice: Return transferred capital while retiring the corresponding strategy principal.

setGoldAllocationAdapter(address).notice: Set the S6-H gold allocation adapter address for combined cap tracking.

setGoldSpreadAdapter(address).notice: Set the S2-H gold spread adapter address for combined cap tracking.

setMaxPendingCrossChainBps(uint256).notice: Owner updates max pending cross-chain cap.

setProfitUnlockPeriod(uint256).notice: Owner updates profit unlock period (board-settable; max 14 days).

setPurificationEscrow(address).notice: Set the PurificationEscrow address for v2 Musharakah profit distribution.

settleCrossChain(uint64,uint256).notice: Write off a lost cross-chain transfer (USDC never arrives or is unrecoverable).

settleCrossChainWithMessage(uint64,bytes.notice: Atomic cross-chain settle: calls MessageTransmitter.receiveMessage in the same         transaction, measures the exact USDC balance delta, and books the result.

sweepFeesToTreasury(address,uint256).notice: Sweep accrued fees to a receiver. Amount is capped to `pendingFees` to         prevent owner from sweeping depositor principal under the guise of fee claims.

totalAssetsBeforeDistributionCut().notice: Pre-cut accounting NAV, also used by the linked hurdle-carry logic.

unlockedAt().notice: Timestamp when lockedProfit finishes unlocking linearly.

unrealizedAdapterLoss().notice: Downward-only non-gold valuation; failed or malformed reads are unmarked.

valuationHealthy().notice: Entry is healthy only when every tracked valuation is readable and non-gold loss is within dust.

writeOffAdapterPrincipal(address).notice: Recognize a total adapter loss before replacing or unlinking its address.

@title  ShariahVaultV2
 @notice V2 extension of ShariahVault that delegates adapter screening to
         ShariahAdapterRegistry rather than a simple `screened[addr]` mapping.
 ## Changes from V1
 1. `deployCapital` now checks `registry.isScreened(strategy)` which verifies:
    - `pronouncementHash != bytes32(0)` (board resolution recorded on-chain)
    - `block.timestamp < expiresAt` (screening has not expired)
 2. The legacy `screened` mapping in ShariahVault is retained for backward
    compatibility (V1 operators can still call V1 methods on the V1 vault).
    V2 ignores `screened` and always uses the registry.
 3. Registry changes require current-board approval and a 30-day timelock.
 ## Migration
 V1 vault deposits and redemptions are always available at NAV (no forced
 migration). V2 is a new deployment; depositors migrate voluntarily.
 See docs/migration-v1-to-v2.md.
 ## Task E checklist
 - deployCapital reverts NotScreened when pronouncementHash == 0   ✓
 - deployCapital reverts when block.timestamp >= expiresAt           ✓
 - non-boardRole cannot call setScreening (uses registry — onlyOwner) ✓
 - ShariahAdapterRegistry enforces 30-day timelock on all changes    ✓
 - V1 vault stays live; this is a new deployment, not an upgrade     ✓
